newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Sugar buys 30,000T U.S. soybeans, corn.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Sugar buys 30,000T U.S. soybeans, corn.

text.p: State-owned Taiwan Sugar Corp bought a combined shipment of 20,000 tonnes of U.S. corn and 10,000 tonnes of U.S. soybeans from Mitsui at a tender on Tuesday, local traders said.
The corn was bought FOB at US$127.60 per tonne while the soybeans were bought FOB at US$271.50 per tonne, all in one shipment from trading giant Mitsui & Co Ltd, traders said.
Freight was fixed at US$18.30 per tonne.

Shipment was slated for November 15-30 delivery from the U.S. Gulf or December 1-15 from the Pacific Northwest, or November 20 to December 5 from the U.S. Gulf or December 5-20 from the Pacific Northwest.
